title: SafeSteps Complete Sequence Knowledge Assessment Universe
description: One thousand sequence-knowledge assessments covering 25 child- and family-support domains across 40 contexts. Every assessment includes five correct ordered steps and one or two plausible distractors.
ethical_use: These learning activities support teaching and formative assessment. Results must not be used alone to determine parenting capacity, child safety, legal outcomes or service eligibility.

assessments.instruction: Select the appropriate actions, exclude any unsuitable actions, then place the selected actions in the safest order.

items.text: Use a suitable breathing, grounding or body-based strategy

items.text: Notice signs that emotions are rising
Discuss what happened and agree on the next helpful step
Reconnect once calm is returning
Pause the interaction and make sure everyone has safe space

feedback.correct: You identified the suitable actions and placed them in a safe, child-focused order.
feedback.partial: You understood part of the process. Review which action must happen first and which plausible action should be left out.
